title: Blockquote
lead: The blockquote component can be used to quote text content from an external source that can be used for testimonials, reviews, and quotes inside an article

prose.text:
Get started with a collection of blockquote components when quoting external sources such as quotes inside an article, user reviews, and testimonials based on multiple examples of layouts, styles, and contexts.

The main `<Blockquote>` component can be used together with the `<cite>` tag or attribute to also mention the source of the quote content.

To start using the component make sure that you have imported it from Flowbite React:

prose.title: Default blockquote
prose.text: Use this example to quote an external source inside a `<Blockquote>` component.

prose.title: Solid background
prose.text: This example can be used as an alternative style to the default one by applying a solid background color.

prose.title: Blockquote icon
prose.text: Use this example to show an icon above the blockquote text content.

prose.title: Paragraph context
prose.text: Use this example to show a `<Blockquote>` component between multiple paragraph elements.

prose.title: User testimonial
prose.text: This example can be used for user testimonials by mentioning the author and occupation of the author.

prose.title: User Review
prose.text: Use this example to show a user review with rating stars and the name and occupation of the author.

prose.title: Alignment
prose.text:
Choose from the following examples the blockquote text alignment from starting from left, center to right based on the utility classes from Tailwind CSS.

The default alignment of the blockquote text content is the left side of the document.

Use the text-center class from Tailwind CSS to align the text content inside the blockquote to the center.

Use the text-right utility class from Tailwind CSS to align the blockquote text content to the right side of the page.

prose.title: Sizes
prose.text:
Choose from one of the multiple sizes for the default blockquote component based on the surrounding elements and sizes.

Use the text-lg font size class from Tailwind CSS to apply the small size for the blockquote component.

Use the text-xl utility class to set the default size for the blockquote element.

The text-2xl class can be used to set a large size for the blockquote component.

prose.title: Theme
prose.text: To learn more about how to customize the appearance of components, please see the [Theme docs](/docs/customize/theme).
